meta.author: Night Owl Design
meta.description: Developed in early 2019, Celtic Heart is an Amiga action-platformer built largely on the Trap Runner engine. Set in a medieval fantasy world, the game follows the Celtic knight Eric on a quest to save his kingdom from an evil force. Players guide Eric through a series of levels, combining platforming, exploration, and combat while facing enemies and environmental challenges. The game was developed for classic Amiga systems and continues the tradition of action-oriented platform games on the platform.
